card.name: Cardiac in neuroleptic malignant syndrome signs
card.fires_on: The word "cardiac" right after "diaphoresis and" at the end of the list of autonomic instability signs, just before "dysrhythmias". This is the standard warning text on neuroleptic malignant syndrome.

modes.label: Cardiac before dysrhythmias
modes.description: "cardiac" closes the list of autonomic signs in a neuroleptic malignant syndrome description.
modes.example: (irregular pulse or blood pressure, tachycardia, diaphoresis and<< cardiac>> dysrhythmias)

card.plain: It fires on the word "cardiac" in the stock sentence listing autonomic signs of neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
